stem: How is the character Maud in the excerpt from Finding Dorothy DIFFERENT from the North Dakota farm boy mentioned in the excerpt from “Big Wheels Keep On Turnin’ ”?

options.label: A
options.text: Maud is more interested in the Ferris wheel, while the farm boy focuses on the overall World’s Columbian Exposition.

options.label: B
options.text: Maud is more cautious about spending money, while the farm boy is willing to spend freely on a new experience.

options.label: C
options.text: Maud is more impressed by new technology, while the farm boy prefers what is familiar.

options.label: D
options.text: Maud is more likely to take unexpected risks, while the farm boy is more practical.
